text.arabic_uthmani: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًۭا وَطَمَعًۭا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ

words.gloss_range: accomplished bodily withdrawal from contact with beds, with Form VI giving reciprocal/self-involved separation rather than ordinary rising
words.root_gloss_range: range of receding, drying, harshness, estrangement, and separation; local grammar selects physical withdrawal from the resting surface with agency in the worshippers

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the believers’ sides as the grammatical subject of withdrawal
the definite lying-places from which contact is broken
the separative preposition governing the bed noun

words.prose: {{ar:تَتَجَافَىٰ}} ({{tr:tatajāfā}}) opens the ayah with motion already achieved: the sides have broken contact before the ongoing calling is described. Its Form VI shape makes the separation feel self-involved and almost reciprocal between body and bed, while {{ar:عَنِ}} ({{tr:ʿani}}) keeps the image locally concrete as withdrawal from a contact-surface. The verb is rare in this form, so the ordinary act of leaving rest becomes linguistically marked; its heavy opening sounds roughen the rest scene rather than letting it feel smooth. Across the boundary it answers 32:15 by moving the same worship profile from falling in prostration to rising from beds, and it reverses the side-posture of remembrance on sides (3:191) while sharing j-f-w separation pressure with discarded foam (13:17).

topics.headline: completed withdrawal before ongoing invocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that bodily separation is established first, while invocation continues after it.
topics.reason: The QAC grammar marks the opening verb as perfect and the following invocation/spending verbs as imperfect, supporting an accomplished-opening then ongoing-action sequence.

topics.headline: separation is governed from the bed surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first word as contact-breaking from beds, not a vague spiritual rising.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ}} ({{tr:al-maḍājiʿi}}) the complement of {{ar:عَنِ}} ({{tr:ʿani}}); the root range supports receding/estrangement while the local preposition and object keep it physically anchored.

topics.headline: Form VI stages self-involved body-bed disengagement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the worshippers are not expelled from sleep; their own bodies participate in the disengagement.
topics.reason: The surface is Form VI with the sides as subject; reciprocal/self-involved separation survives, while a claim that the bed literally acts as an agent is only figurative.

topics.headline: feminine singular agreement makes a collective bodily movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that many sides are grammatically gathered into one unified movement.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:جُنُوبُهُمْ}} ({{tr:junūbuhum}}) as a broken plural subject with feminine singular agreement on {{ar:تَتَجَافَىٰ}} ({{tr:tatajāfā}}), so the grammar licenses the collective effect.

topics.headline: rare opening verb carries boundary and echo pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the bed-rising scene against earlier/larger bodily worship patterns, especially the contrast with remembrance on sides (3:191) and the prior prostration scene (32:15).
topics.reason: The concrete references support echo and boundary contrast, but they do not control the local parse beyond highlighting bodily direction and separation.

topics.headline: sound texture reinforces strained departure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the opening as rougher than a smooth sleep scene because the phonetic texture matches the strain of leaving rest.
topics.reason: The row is an auditory observation rather than grammar, but it has a concrete payoff tied to the first beat and neighboring bed word.

words.gloss_range: the believers’ sides/flanks as the explicit subject, making sleeping bodies concrete while the suffix keeps the prior group in view
words.root_gloss_range: range around side, lateral position, avoidance, and being set aside; local use is literal body-side with avoidance pressure from the separation frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the verb that makes the sides withdraw
the bed noun from which the sides withdraw

words.prose: {{ar:جُنُوبُهُمْ}} ({{tr:junūbuhum}}) makes the body-part that normally touches the bed the grammatical actor. The suffix carries the believers from 32:15 into the new ayah without renaming them, while the plural sides distribute one nocturnal posture across the group. The root field can suggest avoidance and side-position, but here the literal flank remains primary; the avoidance pressure comes from the sides leaving {{ar:ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ}} ({{tr:al-maḍājiʿi}}). That same side field also lets voluntary rising here stand against remembrance while on sides (3:191) and involuntary side exposure in punishment (39:67), without changing the local body-part sense.

topics.headline: sides act before persons are renamed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names the bed-contacting body part as actor, making devotion physically concrete.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment data make {{ar:جُنُوبُهُمْ}} ({{tr:junūbuhum}}) the nominative subject of {{ar:تَتَجَافَىٰ}} ({{tr:tatajāfā}}); the part-whole reading is therefore anchored in syntax.

topics.headline: suffix continues the ayah-15 believers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices continuity: the sleepers, callers, and later spenders are the same believer group from 32:15.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence resolves the possessive suffix back to the believer group in the previous ayah, so the body scene is not a new subject.

topics.headline: broken plural distributes one posture across many bodies
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a shared devotional posture spread across many believers rather than a single isolated ascetic act.
topics.reason: The broken plural and plural suffix support distributed embodiment while the verb agreement gathers the action collectively.

topics.headline: side-root adds avoidance pressure without replacing the literal flank
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the literal sides also sound like deliberate avoidance of ease because the separation frame activates the side/avoidance field.
topics.reason: The local noun is a body part, so ritual-impurity or purity movement is not selected; the valid surviving force is side/avoidance coloring within the bed-separation phrase.

topics.headline: side imagery connects to wider embodied worship contrasts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare voluntary rising from sides here with other side-posture scenes such as remembrance on sides (3:191) and involuntary side exposure in punishment (39:67).
topics.reason: The references are useful contrasts but remain comparative; they do not change the local literal subject.

words.gloss_range: separative preposition marking the beds as the source or contact-surface from which the sides withdraw

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed genitive bed noun

words.prose: {{ar:عَنِ}} ({{tr:ʿani}}) is the small hinge that makes the opening movement spatial and separative. It governs {{ar:ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ}} ({{tr:al-maḍājiʿi}}), so the beds are not the location where the scene stays but the surface from which contact breaks. Its recitational form also leans into the following definite noun, making preposition and bed-word a tight unit.

topics.headline: preposition marks the bed as source of withdrawal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sides move off a contact surface, not merely away in an abstract devotional mood.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces {{ar:ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ}} ({{tr:al-maḍājiʿi}}) as the complement governed by {{ar:عَنِ}} ({{tr:ʿani}}); translation support explicitly warns to preserve source rather than static location.

topics.headline: vowelized particle binds into the bed noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the separation marker as dependent on the bed-word, matching the syntactic dependency.
topics.reason: The surface form and following governed noun support a small sound-syntax payoff without changing the semantic role.

words.gloss_range: definite plural lying-places as the familiar source left behind, concretely the places where sides recline
words.root_gloss_range: range of lying down, reclining on the side, lying-place, and possible indolence; local use selects concrete beds/resting-places with torpor as secondary pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the sides whose normal resting relation to the bed is broken

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ}} ({{tr:al-maḍājiʿi}}) closes the first beat on the rest-place being left behind. As a definite plural noun of place, it names familiar lying-places rather than abstract sleep, and its derivation from lying on the side fits tightly with {{ar:جُنُوبُهُمْ}} ({{tr:junūbuhum}}). The root can carry an indolence shadow, but the local anchor is concrete: known beds become the source-point of departure. Because the root is rare and constrained to lying-place forms, this ordinary bed image becomes lexically marked and starts the ayah’s movement through body, emotion, provision, and spending.

topics.headline: genitive bed noun is the departure source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the bed as the endpoint of the opening phrase and the source left behind.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ}} ({{tr:al-maḍājiʿi}}) as genitive under {{ar:عَنِ}} ({{tr:ʿani}}), and attachment evidence makes it the complement of the opening withdrawal verb.

topics.headline: definite plural makes rest familiar and ordinary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse turns a familiar human resting-place into the thing devotion leaves.
topics.reason: The definite article, plural number, and noun-of-place tag support familiar concrete beds rather than a newly introduced abstract sleep concept.

topics.headline: lying-place is built for the side that now leaves it
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the internal fit: the side-word and bed-word belong to one body-place mechanism that the ayah separates.
topics.reason: The root evidence for lying on the side and the local proximity of side and bed words support the body-place echo.

topics.headline: place noun objectifies rest as a location to leave
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not say they stop sleeping; it locates rest as a concrete place the body departs.
topics.reason: The noun-of-place tag and separative preposition select concrete lying-places over a finite lying verb or abstract sleep field.

topics.headline: lying-root can shade the beds with indolence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the beds as more than furniture: they carry the pull of torpor that the bodies resist.
topics.reason: Indolence is a lexical extension, not the local denotation; it survives only as coloring on the concrete bed image.

topics.headline: rare bed-root participates in the body-emotion-wealth arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ordinary bed scene as lexically marked and as the first node in a larger body, emotion, provision, and spending profile.
topics.reason: The occurrence evidence supports rarity, while the local clause sequence supports the body-to-emotion-to-wealth progression.

words.gloss_range: ongoing directed invocation of their Lord, with the broader call/petition/claim range narrowed by the explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: range of calling, invoking, inviting, petitioning, summoning, and claiming; local frame selects worshipful address to the Lord while retaining relational claim force

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the explicit addressee of the calling

words.prose: {{ar:يَدْعُونَ}} ({{tr:yadʿūna}}) shifts from bodily withdrawal into ongoing address. Its implicit plural subject keeps the 32:15 believers active, and the explicit object {{ar:رَبَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbahum}}) narrows the broad call-root to worshipful invocation rather than undirected vocality. The call is also a performed relationship, not only a request: praise from 32:15 becomes petitionary address here, with sound links drawing the invocation toward Lordship and provision. Because no conjunction separates it from the opening clause, the calling can sit inside the same scene as the body’s withdrawal, with fear and longing immediately naming its inner posture.

topics.headline: dropped subject keeps prior believers active
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same believers continue acting without being renamed.
topics.reason: The 3mp subject is implicit and resolved to the believer group from 32:15, matching the suffix chain across the ayah.

topics.headline: explicit object fixes addressed prayer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the call has a named addressee: their Lord, not a vague cry.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:رَبَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbahum}}) the direct object of {{ar:يَدْعُونَ}} ({{tr:yadʿūna}}); corpus pairing supports the recognizable call-upon-Lord formula.

topics.headline: imperfect calling continues after rising
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears prayer as an ongoing practice unfolding after the bodily break from rest.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb after the perfect opening supports sustained or repeated invocation within the scene.

topics.headline: call-root includes petition and relational claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that calling their Lord is also a performed relationship, not only a request for things.
topics.reason: The broad d-ʿ-w range survives as directed summons/petition/claim, but the explicit Lord object blocks unrelated claim or invitation readings.

topics.headline: asyndetic calling shares the withdrawal scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees body, voice, and fear as one devotional moment rather than separate reports.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses the calling clause as circumstantial to the opening withdrawal and ties fear as its manner or motive.

topics.headline: praise becomes petitionary address across the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices continuity of vocal worship from praise in 32:15 into calling in 32:16, with sound links toward Lordship and provision.
topics.reason: The boundary contrast is concrete and useful, while the sound thread remains supporting texture rather than a governing parse.

words.gloss_range: their Lord as the definite relational addressee of invocation, joining mastery, nurture, and later provision
words.root_gloss_range: range of lordship, ownership, mastery, nurture, raising, and regulation; local construct selects the believers’ sustaining Lord as addressee

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the later provision act that concretizes Lordship

words.prose: {{ar:رَبَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbahum}}) gives the calling its relational object. The construct with the suffix makes the Lord specifically theirs, while the singular title gathers the plural callers under one addressee. The same suffix shifts from their sides to their Lord, preserving the relation across the posture change from 32:15 into 32:16. The root range of mastery and nurture prepares the later provision clause: the one invoked as Lord is the one whose provision becomes the source of spending, inside Surah 32’s repeated Lordship thread.

topics.headline: their Lord is definite by relational suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title is not detached; it is bound to the believers as their shared Lord.
topics.reason: QAC marks construct definiteness with the 3mp suffix, and cross-reference evidence ties the suffix to the same believer group.

topics.headline: accusative object names the authority addressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammatical object is an addressed authority, not something acted upon.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:رَبَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbahum}}) the object of {{ar:يَدْعُونَ}} ({{tr:yadʿūna}}); semantic role distinguishes addressee-authority from affected patient.

topics.headline: suffix shifts from body relation to Lord relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same group from their sides to their Lord as the posture changes.
topics.reason: The same suffix chain continues the referent while the relation changes from embodied possession to devotional address.

topics.headline: Rabb semantics prepare provision and spending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees later provision as an expression of the Lordship already named in the prayer clause.
topics.reason: The root range includes nurture/mastery, and local sequence moves from Lord as addressee to provision as divine allocation.

topics.headline: calling-Lord formula joins Surah 32 lordship thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the familiar calling-Lord pairing inside Surah 32’s repeated Lordship network and across the boundary from 32:15.
topics.reason: The recurrence evidence supports formula and same-surah thread, but the local construct remains the controlling sense.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative fear as both possible motive and state of invocation, paired with hopeful desire
words.root_gloss_range: range of fear, apprehension, anticipatory harm-awareness, and diminution in some derivatives; local use selects inner risk-aware fear before the Lord

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the paired longing/desire pole

words.prose: {{ar:خَوْفًۭا}} ({{tr:khawfan}}) names the first inner pole of the calling. Its accusative form can mark why they call and the state in which they call, so fear remains both motive and atmosphere. The simple indefinite maṣdar leaves fear as an unnamed internal state rather than a caused fright, while the takhawwafa diminution image can lightly color fear as reducing attachment to rest. The word is balanced by {{ar:طَمَعًۭا}} ({{tr:ṭamaʿan}}): the invocation is neither only dread nor only desire, but a future-facing posture before their Lord, and the matching -an cadence makes the pair audible as a unit.

topics.headline: fear is motive and/or state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fear can explain the calling and describe the callers at the same time.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the accusative as motive or manner, preserving both causal and circumstantial roles.

topics.headline: fear is anticipatory risk-awareness before the Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees fear as a relational posture toward the Lord rather than a stray mood.
topics.reason: The semantic field supports anticipatory harm-awareness, and local placement after calling their Lord gives it relational direction.

topics.headline: fear and longing form a balanced dyad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a two-pole emotional structure: dread and longing stand together in the same grammatical shape.
topics.reason: The conjunction at {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates {{ar:خَوْفًۭا}} ({{tr:khawfan}}) with {{ar:طَمَعًۭا}} ({{tr:ṭamaʿan}}); co-occurrence evidence and matching accusatives support the formulaic pair, including the supplied echo at 7:56.

topics.headline: tanwīn leaves fear qualitatively open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices fear as an unnamed inner state, not a caused fright imposed by an external actor.
topics.reason: The simple indefinite verbal noun names fear itself and not causative fear-making forms.

topics.headline: diminution image can color reduced attachment to rest
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may hear fear as part of what lessens the pull of rest, while the primary sense remains fear.
topics.reason: The derivative diminution sense is not the surface meaning, but it can cautiously color the local sequence after bodies leave beds.

topics.headline: matching -an sound makes the pair audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears fear and longing as a balanced sound unit before the semantic opposition is unpacked.
topics.reason: The paired indefinite accusative endings are concrete surface evidence for auditory balance.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that holds fear and longing as simultaneous parallel poles

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the fear pole
the longing pole

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) holds the emotional pair together. It coordinates {{ar:طَمَعًۭا}} ({{tr:ṭamaʿan}}) with {{ar:خَوْفًۭا}} ({{tr:khawfan}}) under the same accusative role, so the two states are simultaneous rather than sequential. The particle preserves the polarity instead of letting either noun explain away the other, and its shortness creates a light acoustic hinge between the two matching -an maṣdars.

topics.headline: wāw binds two accusative motivation nouns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fear and longing operate together in one supplicatory frame.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:طَمَعًۭا}} ({{tr:ṭamaʿan}}) conjoined with {{ar:خَوْفًۭا}} ({{tr:khawfan}}); the conjunction is coordination, not sequence.

topics.headline: connector preserves the two-pole opposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fear is not reduced to desire and desire is not reduced to fear.
topics.reason: The particle coordinates lexical opposites in parallel form, preserving antithesis within unity.

topics.headline: short connector balances the tanwīn pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a light hinge between two matching accusative sounds.
topics.reason: The sound payoff is small but concrete and tied to the paired nouns.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative longing or hopeful desire, grammatically parallel to fear and open as to its desired object
words.root_gloss_range: range of eager desire, coveting, aspiration, and hope; local fear-pair selects hopeful longing while preserving a sharper desire edge

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the paired fear pole

words.prose: {{ar:طَمَعًۭا}} ({{tr:ṭamaʿan}}) completes the emotional dyad. It matches {{ar:خَوْفًۭا}} ({{tr:khawfan}}) in accusative form and role, so longing is not secondary to fear. The root can carry coveting as well as hope; in this paired invocation frame the positive hopeful sense is selected, while the desired object remains unnamed and open. Its simple maṣdar form names their own interior longing rather than a causative desire produced by another, and the word completes a recognizable fear-hope pattern also seen in 7:56, 13:12, and 30:24 before the ayah turns to spending.

topics.headline: longing repeats fear’s grammatical role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that longing is grammatically equal to fear in the invocation frame.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment data make {{ar:طَمَعًۭا}} ({{tr:ṭamaʿan}}) an accusative verbal noun parallel to {{ar:خَوْفًۭا}} ({{tr:khawfan}}).

topics.headline: state of desire is named without specifying its object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices future-oriented longing without the ayah narrowing it to one named reward.
topics.reason: The surface maṣdar names the state of desire, while no object of desire is supplied locally.

topics.headline: sharp desire edge is disciplined by the fear-pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears hopeful aspiration with the stronger edge of eager desire still audible.
topics.reason: The lexical range can include coveting/greed, but the pairing with fear in worship selects hope as the local sense.

topics.headline: simple maṣdar names internal longing directly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the desire is their inner state, not something another agent causes in them.
topics.reason: The local form is a simple indefinite maṣdar, contrasting with distributionally common causative Form IV uses in the broader root evidence.

topics.headline: longing completes the recurring fear-hope formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the invocation beat closes only after the second pole of the known fear-hope pattern arrives.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and reference evidence support the pair, including 7:56, 13:12, and 30:24; locally it closes the emotional beat before spending.

words.gloss_range: clause-opening conjunction that pivots from invocation and emotion into provision-sourced spending

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the source/partitive phrase introduced after the conjunction

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) prevents the ayah from stopping at inner emotion. It opens the provision-and-spending clause as either coordination or resumptive continuation, so material worship becomes a new dimension of the same believer profile rather than an afterthought or a gloss on prayer. Its position after fear and longing begins the closing wealth beat in the body, voice, emotion, and wealth progression.

topics.headline: second conjunction opens a new worship dimension
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a pivot from vocal-emotional worship into material action, while coordination remains grammatically possible.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the spending clause; the supplied istiʾnāf force is plausible as discourse effect, but not exclusive of coordination.

topics.headline: wāw links spending to invocation in one profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees spending as coordinated with prayer, not detached from the devotional portrait.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the spending verb with the calling verb and places the provision clause under the same believer profile.

topics.headline: hinge begins the closing wealth beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sequence moving from body to voice and emotion into wealth.
topics.reason: The row names the local structural position of the conjunction before the final material clause.

words.gloss_range: fused source/partitive phrase, from what, fronted before the spending verb to make provision the gate for expenditure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the relative provision clause governed inside the phrase
the delayed spending verb whose resource frame has already been supplied

words.prose: {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) compresses source, partitive limit, and open-ended provision before the spending verb arrives. The fused preposition-plus-relative form means they spend from what was provided, not from autonomous possession; fronting the phrase makes provision the interpretive gate for {{ar:يُنفِقُونَ}} ({{tr:yunfiqūna}}). The relative element leaves the kind of provision open while the preposition limits the act to a source and portion. As one written form, it visibly carries source, part, and relative openness together, and its nasal cohesion with the provision verb makes the source phrase audible before the final spending verb. It also belongs to the ayah’s three-beat architecture: sides withdraw, they call, and they spend.

topics.headline: fused min plus relative mā marks source and portion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that spending is both sourced in provision and limited as a portion from it.
topics.reason: QAC parses the word as preposition plus relative pronoun, and attachment evidence makes it the prepositional complement frame for spending.

topics.headline: fronted provision phrase controls the spending clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the source of spending before the act, so expenditure is framed as response to allocation.
topics.reason: The phrase {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) {{ar:رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:razaqnāhum}}) precedes {{ar:يُنفِقُونَ}} ({{tr:yunfiqūna}}); attachment evidence treats the relative provision clause as the governed resource expression.

topics.headline: relative mā leaves the provision field unspecified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the resource is not reduced to one category such as money, food, or knowledge.
topics.reason: The relative element introduces what was provided without a specified noun, and the following provision verb supplies the content.

topics.headline: written fusion mirrors semantic compression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one compact word carrying source, portion, and open relative content before the verb.
topics.reason: The surface fusion is real and aligns with the compact source-first syntax.

topics.headline: source phrase participates in body-voice-wealth architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is not only about night prayer but about bodily, vocal, and material devotion.
topics.reason: The clause structure identifies three verbal beats: sides withdraw, they call, and they spend.

topics.headline: nasal sounds bind the source phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the provision-source phrase as cohesive before the final verb lands.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is concrete and local to the fused phrase plus provision verb.

words.gloss_range: completed divine provision to them, left open in type and placed before ongoing human spending
words.root_gloss_range: range of provision, sustenance, livelihood, share, allocation, and provider titles; local verb selects a completed act of giving/allocation by the divine speaker

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the Lord invoked before provision is named
the ongoing spending response from provision
the open source phrase that frames the provision

words.prose: {{ar:رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:razaqnāhum}}) inserts the divine provider directly into the third-person portrait: “We” provided, and the suffix marks the believers as recipients. Its perfect aspect places allocation before the ongoing spending, while {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) leaves the kind of provision open beyond one resource type. The provision is already given, not being sought, and the same suffix chain keeps the sleepers, callers, recipients, and spenders as one group. The word also links the Lord they call, {{ar:رَبَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbahum}}), to the resources from which they spend, so worship and expenditure answer the same source.

topics.headline: one verb assigns divine giver and human recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both sides of provision inside one word: divine “We” as giver and the believers as recipients.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a 1cp subject and 3mp object suffix on the provision verb.

topics.headline: completed provision grounds ongoing spending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees spending as response to prior allocation, not as autonomous generosity.
topics.reason: The provision verb is perfect while {{ar:يُنفِقُونَ}} ({{tr:yunfiqūna}}) is imperfect, yielding prior allocation before ongoing expenditure.

topics.headline: first-person divine voice claims the provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the narration shift from describing them to divine speech claiming the resource source.
topics.reason: The 1cp subject changes the voice inside a third-person description, making the provision clause a direct divine claim.

topics.headline: open provision field is broad but locally an allocation act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what was provided can include more than money, while the local verb remains a concrete completed allocation.
topics.reason: The root range includes sustenance, livelihood, share, and provider titles; the local surface is a Form I perfect verb, not a divine name.

topics.headline: provided provision contrasts with seeking provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause is about already received provision, not acquisition or asking for resources.
topics.reason: The surface is the basic provision verb in perfect, not the Form X seeking-provision form.

topics.headline: relative provision clause mediates source and expenditure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the provision clause as the bridge between what comes from God and what leaves through the believers.
topics.reason: The verb sits inside {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) before {{ar:يُنفِقُونَ}} ({{tr:yunfiqūna}}), making provided resources the source frame for spending.

topics.headline: Lordship becomes concrete provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Lord invoked in the prayer clause is concretized as provider in the spending clause.
topics.reason: The local movement from {{ar:رَبَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbahum}}) to {{ar:رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:razaqnāhum}}) is supported by co-occurrence and same-surah Lordship patterns.

topics.headline: same believers become recipients before spenders
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows one referent chain from sleepers to callers to provision recipients and spenders.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence resolves the 3mp suffix to the same believer group, carrying the profile into the material clause.

words.gloss_range: ongoing plural spending/outward expenditure from provided resources, with Form IV agency and final-word closure
words.root_gloss_range: range of spending, outflow, passing through, exhaustion, saleability, tunnel/passage, and hypocrisy; local provision phrase selects positive agentive expenditure from divine provision

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the fronted source/partitive resource frame
the completed provision from which spending proceeds

words.prose: {{ar:يُنفِقُونَ}} ({{tr:yunfiqūna}}) is the ayah’s final landing: ongoing human expenditure from what was first provided. The fronted {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) {{ar:رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:razaqnāhum}}) has already supplied the resource frame, so the final verb is not vague objectless spending but source-governed outflow. The provision phrase selects the positive spending branch, while hidden-exit and hypocrisy associations remain contrastive background rather than the local sense. Its Form IV agency makes the believers active channelers, not people watching wealth disappear, and the root’s passage imagery helps the body’s earlier departure from beds return as the departure of resources from possession. The final plural ending keeps the same believers audible at closure and shares cadence with the earlier calling verb.

topics.headline: pro-drop plural subject leaves action at the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word lands on the believers’ ongoing action while their identity remains carried in the verb ending.
topics.reason: The 3mp imperfect ending supplies the subject and keeps the same believers active at closure.

topics.headline: imperfect spending follows completed provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees spending as repeated disposition after prior divine allocation.
topics.reason: Aspect contrast between {{ar:رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ}} ({{tr:razaqnāhum}}) and {{ar:يُنفِقُونَ}} ({{tr:yunfiqūna}}) supports prior provision and ongoing human response.

topics.headline: resource frame is supplied before the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the source before the action, so spending is framed by provision rather than by possession.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) the prepositional complement of {{ar:يُنفِقُونَ}} ({{tr:yunfiqūna}}); the delayed verb inherits that resource frame.

topics.headline: provision phrase selects positive economic outflow
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the n-f-q family’s hidden-exit and hypocrisy associations are contrasted, not selected, while sincere outward spending is active.
topics.reason: The local provision phrase selects expenditure; hypocrisy and hidden-exit imagery survive only as contrastive background, not as the local sense.

topics.headline: Form IV makes believers cause resources to pass outward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees spending as deliberate channeling outward, not mere loss or disappearance of wealth.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as Form IV, supporting agentive causative outflow from the broader passage/spending root image.

topics.headline: final word turns devotion into material outflow
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not close on inner emotion but on outward expenditure.
topics.reason: The clause sequence and final-word placement support body-to-voice-to-wealth progression with spending as the closure.

topics.headline: spending closes a chain from Lordship to provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees generosity as downstream from the Lord they call and the provision they received.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence evidence and the local source phrase connect Lordship, provision, and spending in one sequence.

topics.headline: departure from bed returns as departure of wealth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a bookend: bodies depart comfort at the start, resources depart possession at the end.
topics.reason: The opening {{ar:تَتَجَافَىٰ}} ({{tr:tatajāfā}}) and closing {{ar:يُنفِقُونَ}} ({{tr:yunfiqūna}}) frame the ayah with two outward movements.

topics.headline: two imperfect plural verbs share cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears calling and spending linked by the shared plural imperfect ending.
topics.reason: The surface endings of {{ar:يَدْعُونَ}} ({{tr:yadʿūna}}) and {{ar:يُنفِقُونَ}} ({{tr:yunfiqūna}}) are parallel and support the link between vocal and material actions.

baseline_models.mechanism: The clause reverses a precise body-surface relation: the side, whose resting posture is adhesion to a lateral surface, repeatedly refuses that adhesion and makes distance.

activation_trace.role: Non-adherence supplies the active separation that governs the posture.
The bodily side supplies the moving surface rather than an abstract self.
Lateral adhesion to the ground supplies the resting relation being reversed.

changed_reading.before: They get out of bed to worship.
changed_reading.after: Their worship begins as a repeated bodily unfastening: the very side fitted to cling to a resting surface creates distance from it.

baseline_models.mechanism: Calling is a speech-act of inclination toward the sustaining Lord while fear repels from anticipated harm and hope attracts toward desired good; the prayer is generated inside both vectors, not after either is resolved.

activation_trace.role: Vocal calling that inclines toward an addressee supplies the central directed act.
Progressive nurture and completion make the addressee the one toward whom need is directed.
Anticipation of harm supplies the repelling vector.
The heart's expectant desire supplies the attracting vector.

changed_reading.before: They pray with two named emotions, fear and hope.
changed_reading.after: Their call holds an unresolved push-pull field: feared harm drives them away while hoped-for nurture draws them toward the same Lord.

baseline_models.mechanism: An apportioned arrival is deliberately made to leave, and the outlet branch of expenditure turns the recipients into a route through which provision continues rather than its terminal owners.

activation_trace.role: An apportioned grant supplies the incoming share.
The going-out of wealth supplies the explicit outward transfer.
A passage with an outlet recasts the giver as conduit rather than endpoint.

changed_reading.before: They donate part of what they own.
changed_reading.after: What reaches them as an allotted gift remains provision by passing outward through them; reception creates a channel, not a stopping place.

baseline_models.mechanism: The bed can carry the branch of lying down on an undertaking; withdrawal then becomes refusal of neglected responsibility, immediately realized in a verbal act and a material act.

activation_trace.role: Abandoning or slackening in an affair supplies an ethical second layer to the bed.
Breaking adhesion supplies the transition out of that inaction.
Directed speech supplies the first resumed action.
Outgoing wealth supplies the second resumed action and makes the return to duty material.

changed_reading.before: The verse praises loss of sleep followed by prayer and charity.
changed_reading.after: The physical rising also images recovery from neglected charge: inertia is broken and responsibility resumes in both address and expenditure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier descent, managed consequence, and ascent turn the focus provision-passage model into a circulation: what is delivered downward is answered by a body that disengages and by provision routed onward rather than arrested.

activation_trace.role: Delivery downward supplies the incoming leg of the circulation.
Ordering an affair by its outcome supplies continuity across the circuit.
Ascent supplies the returning leg rather than a one-way descent.
The apportioned gift is the focus-level arrival entering the circuit.
The open passage makes the recipient a relay within that circuit.

structural_cues: 32:2 introduces delivery; 32:5 explicitly sequences heaven-to-earth movement and return; 32:16 couples receipt with outflow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, consequence-aware ordering, ascent, receipt, and an outlet; I infer one circulation joining them. A live alternative keeps cosmic administration and personal giving as parallel but separate motions.

changed_reading.before: Provision arrives and believers independently give some away.
changed_reading.after: Night prayer and expenditure answer an already moving order: received good is not arrested at the self but relayed into a larger descent-and-return circulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies forced head inversion, responsive falling in prostration, and then withdrawal of the sides from beds. The focus movement is therefore not generic upwardness; it belongs to a choreography in which moral agency appears in what the body willingly lowers before and what it refuses to remain attached to.

activation_trace.role: The lowered head supplies an involuntary terminal posture of shame.
A sudden falling motion supplies the voluntary transition into worship.
Deliberate lowliness supplies the chosen downward posture.
Non-adhesion supplies the contrasting chosen movement away from comfort.
Grounded lateral adhesion identifies the posture they refuse to prolong.

structural_cues: The ordered posture sequence is inverted heads in 32:12, falling prostrate in 32:15, then sides separating from beds in 32:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three body orientations; I assign agency and object as the contrastive arrow. They may instead be only separate scenes of judgment, prostration, and night vigil.

changed_reading.before: Piety is pictured as rising upward out of bed.
changed_reading.after: Piety governs bodily yield: they willingly go low before the signs, refuse low adhesion to comfort, and thereby differ from those lowered without agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah answers the rejected visible resting place with a hidden settling of the eyes awarded in return. The focus is not hostility to repose but an exchange between immediately available bodily settlement and concealed perceptual settlement.

activation_trace.role: Separation supplies the relinquishment of present settlement.
Bodily adhesion identifies the visible repose being relinquished.
Concealment keeps the alternative repose unavailable to present sight.
Settling and quieting of the eye supplies the replacement repose.
The seeing eye relocates rest from the body's side to perception.
Reciprocal recompense supplies the exchange relation between the two forms of rest.

structural_cues: 32:17 immediately follows the focus and shifts from sides and beds to hidden eye-settling as recompense for action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, present detachment, hidden eye-settling, and recompense; I infer substitution between two reposes. The live alternative is a simpler sacrifice-then-reward sequence without material symmetry.

changed_reading.before: They sacrifice sleep because they hope for an unspecified reward.
changed_reading.after: They relinquish one kind of settling for another: visible bodily adhesion now is exchanged for a hidden settling of perception later.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired future abodes sharpen two focus exits: sides successfully leave a bed and provision successfully leaves through an outlet, while those in the adverse abode repeatedly attempt to leave and are returned. Present detachability becomes morally urgent agency.

activation_trace.role: Successful separation supplies a present bodily exit.
A route with an outlet supplies a present material exit.
Joining a shelter supplies the favorable terminal abode.
Prepared hospitality makes that abode a receiving destination.
Joining a shelter also supplies the adverse terminal enclosure.
Penetration to the outside supplies the attempted escape.
Return after departure blocks the escape by restoring enclosure.

structural_cues: 32:19 and 32:20 parallel two abodes, but 32:20 repeats an attempted exit followed by forced return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present focus exits and a later exit-return trap; I read the bed as a micro-abode and current detachment as rehearsal. The alternative is that the focus vigil and future abodes share no operative spatial analogy.

changed_reading.before: Leaving bed and spending are two meritorious acts.
changed_reading.after: Both acts exercise the present capacity for release: body and provision can still pass outward, unlike the later enclosure from which attempted exit only produces forced return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Around the focus, bodily turning-away is repeated with different objects: responsive people detach from beds, the wrongdoer turns a side away from remembered signs, and the messenger is told to turn from the rejecters. Withdrawal is not intrinsically virtuous; fidelity lies in selecting the right attachment and refusal.

activation_trace.role: Active non-attachment supplies the focus instance of turning away.
The bodily side makes withdrawal materially visible.
A reminder supplies the claim from which the wrongdoer withdraws.
Turning one's side away supplies the culpable mirror of the focus movement.
The same side-turning becomes commanded when directed away from persistent rejecters.

structural_cues: The focus, 32:22, and 32:30 each construct withdrawal with عَنْ, while changing its object from beds to signs to rejecters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared spatial grammar, side semantics, and three objects; I infer deliberate moral discrimination by object. The live alternative treats the recurrence as ordinary idiom without a designed contrast.

changed_reading.before: Separation from attachment is itself the pious movement.
changed_reading.after: The ayah trains selective attachment: leave the bed, never leave the signs, and recognize that even turning away can be commanded when its object changes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later water sequence gives the focus provision-passage a material analogue: directed supply enters plantless ground, emerges as growth, and becomes an edible share. Expenditure can therefore be read as generative redistribution into a site of lack, not simple subtraction from the giver.

activation_trace.role: Rain as provision links the focus gift to the later water circuit.
A passage with an outlet supplies the transmission structure.
Driving a flow supplies directed delivery rather than accidental diffusion.
Land stripped of vegetation supplies the receiving site of lack.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies transformed re-emergence.
Cultivated growth supplies the productive effect of the delivered resource.
An edible apportioned share completes the flow as renewed provision.

structural_cues: 32:27 orders a material chain: water is driven to barren land, growth is brought out, and creatures consume it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain-provision, an outlet, and the later water-to-food chain; I infer social expenditure follows the same generative hydraulics. The alternative leaves the agricultural sign and human giving as separate examples of provision.

changed_reading.before: Spending diminishes a received stock for another's benefit.
changed_reading.after: Spending routes provision into barrenness so that it can re-emerge as another's share; apparent loss at the source is one stage of growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant د ع ع mapping behind the focus form rather than the ordinary call branch. It remains anchored to word 5 and coheres with the body's release from the bed, but downstream prose should present it only as a secondary phonetic-morphological activation, not as the lexical gloss of يَدْعُونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَدْعُونَ within the bodily movement away from the beds

activation_trace.role: Ordinary directed calling preserves the surface action of the focus verb.
The encouragement to a stumbler to rise or recover makes the call echo the body's own recovery from recumbency.
Physical non-adhesion gives the recovery echo a visible focus anchor.

changed_reading.before: After rising, they direct prayer to their Lord.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the call also reverberates as a recovery-command: in calling, the recumbent self enacts 'rise and recover' as well as addressing the Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant and cross-domain because it links the cast-off residue branch of ج ف و to rain, outlet, and irrigation. It remains anchored in the focus detachment-provision-expenditure sequence and is reinforced by 32:27's explicit flow chain; downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy, never as a direct translation of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَتَجَافَىٰ joined to رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ and يُنفِقُونَ

activation_trace.role: Residue cast to the side by a current supplies a clearing rather than merely rising image.
Rain-like provision supplies the moving medium.
A through-passage supplies continued flow instead of accumulation.
Driven water gives the focus branches an explicit contextual flow analogue.
Plantless ground supplies the dry destination toward which cleared provision can move.

changed_reading.before: They push themselves away from beds and then give from provision.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, wakefulness clears what clings while generosity keeps provision moving through an open channel toward a dry receiving place.

strongest_changes: The posture sequence replaces a simple upward piety with deliberate control over when the body descends and what it leaves.
The immediate hidden eye-settling turns rejected sleep into an exchange between visible and concealed repose.
Repeated turning-away constructions make detachment morally selective rather than inherently good.
The later water-to-food chain transforms expenditure from depletion into generative redistribution.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah behaves as a compact hinge: side, bed, call, affect, provision, and outlet preserve several simultaneous geometries of posture, attraction, circulation, selective refusal, and growth without requiring one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The vertical circulation may be thematic parallelism rather than one causal circuit.
The bed-as-micro-abode and hydraulic-clearance readings depend on explicit but distant material analogies.
The د ع ع recovery activation is licensed by the split inventory but should remain subordinate to ordinary calling.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Devotion begins as a deliberate break in bodily contact.** `ج ف و:B001` is standing off from contact and explicitly includes the side separating from a bed; `ج ن ب:B001` identifies the bodily or spatial side. The present-tense verbs continue the responsive movement of 32:15 from falling in prostration to sides repeatedly drawing away from resting places. **Inferred arrow:** the bed's invitation to remain joined -> chosen separation -> wakeful calling on the Lord. The image diagnoses disciplined detachment, not mere sleeplessness.

2. **Fear and desire form a two-directional calling mechanism.** `خ و ف:B001` anticipates harm, while `ط م ع:B001` is heartfelt desire and hope. Their coordinated accusatives attach both motives to the same *yadʿūna rabbahum* without letting either replace the other. **Inferred arrow:** apprehended loss pushes away from danger + hoped-for good draws toward the Lord -> sustained invocation. The pairing keeps devotion from collapsing into either panic or appetite alone.

3. **Received provision is given an outward route.** `ر ز ق:B001` is an allotted provision or gift, and *mimmā razaqnāhum* places receipt before `ن ف ق:B002`, outward expenditure of wealth. As a secondary image, `ن ف ق:B003` is a tunnel with an exit; 32:20, still inside the focus window, will depict attempted exit from fire being blocked. **Packet relation:** gift -> expenditure is syntactically explicit. **Inferred resonance:** what arrives from the Lord is kept alive socially by finding a voluntary outlet, contrasting with the later compulsory enclosure.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 32:20 unexpectedly activated the secondary exit image of `ن ف ق:B003`. Provision voluntarily finds an outward route in 32:16, whereas those enclosed by fire repeatedly seek an exit and are returned; 32:21 adds that corrective moral return is available only before that enclosure.

baseline.text: Yanları yataklardan uzaklaşır; Rablerine korku ve umutla yalvarırlar, kendilerine verdiğimiz şeylerden harcarlar.

findings.text: Bedenin yatakla temasını kesmesi, bir yakınlıktan ayrılarak Rabbe seslenme yakınlığına yönelen bilinçli bir mekân değişimidir.
Korku zarardan uzaklaştırırken umut Rabbe doğru çeker; iki yönlü etki, yakarışı yalnız paniğe ya da isteğe indirgenmekten korur.
Verilenlerin dışarı çıkışı, alan kişiyi nimetin son deposu değil, başkalarına ulaştığı bir geçit gibi düşündürür; ileride ateşten çıkışın kapanması bu çağrışımı tersinden güçlendirir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 (32:11-20) The Night Economy of Release and Reserve
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Bodies and possessions move outward in present devotion while compensating refreshment remains concealed for later disclosure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Expenditure becomes passage through an outlet, and the unseen reward takes the form of a cool, covered water-source held in reserve.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Bodies leave their beds
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Sides detach from sleeping surfaces, rise into vocal invocation, and remain suspended between fear and desire.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lifting away from contact (quranic:root_000251:B001/m01); bodily side (quranic:root_000262:B001/m01); side laid against the ground or bed (quranic:root_000902:B001/m01); vocal summons (quranic:root_000478:B001/m01); fear of expected harm (quranic:root_000447:B001/m01); hopeful desire (quranic:root_000951:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 32:16 `تتجافى` (ج ف و), `جنوبهم` (ج ن ب), `المضاجع` (ض ج ع), `يدعون` (د ع و), `خوفا` (خ و ف), `طمعا` (ط م ع)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The devotional act begins as a precise contact change: the body's side ceases to adhere to its resting place. That physical separation opens a vocal relation whose two tensions are expected harm and desired good.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Provision passes outward
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Assigned sustenance leaves possession through expenditure figured as a passage with a hidden outlet.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: allotted provision (quranic:root_000560:B001/m01); food that enters the body (quranic:root_000560:B002/m01); rain as life-giving provision (quranic:root_000560:B003/m01); depletion by going out (quranic:root_001537:B001/m01); money leaving in expenditure (quranic:root_001537:B002/m01); underground passage with an exit (quranic:root_001537:B003/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Provision is first apportioned inwardly as food or rain, then deliberately sent outward as expenditure. The tunnel-image in the expenditure root gives that transfer a mechanism: value disappears from one enclosure because it has passed through an outlet toward another.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin başka bir şeye oturmamasını veya yapışık kalmamasını; eyerin sırttan kalkması ve böğrün döşekten uzak durmasıyla açıklar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu fiziksel ilişkiyi doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği fiziksel temasın veya yerleşmenin sürmemesidir; ilişkide soğukluk ve taşkının attığı artık bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel uzak durma çekirdeği ile eyer, böğür ve yük semeri üzerinden kurulan belirli kullanımlar ayrı tutulur; belirli bir söz öbeğinin kapsamı bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başka bir şeye oturup yapışık kalmaması, ondan kalkması veya arada temas bırakmayacak biçimde uzak durmasıdır. Genel durum, kendiliğinden uzaklaşma ve bir nesneyi temas ettiği yerden kaldırma kullanımları bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey başka bir şeye yerleşmez veya yapışık kalmaz; ondan kalkar ya da uzak durur.
Eyer, hayvanın sırtına oturmayıp sırttan yukarıda veya uzakta kalabilir.
Uyuyan kişinin böğrünün döşeğe değmemesi, temas etmeme durumuna örnek olur.
Bir varlık, temas ettiği şeyden kendiliğinden çekilip uzaklaşabilir veya yükselebilir.
Yük semeri, devenin sırtından uzaklaştırılarak artık sırta basmayacak duruma getirilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, iki şey arasındaki yerleşik temasın kurulmaması veya sürmemesidir; eyer, böğür ve yük semeri kullanımları bu ilişkinin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

error_profile.loses: Kişinin böğrünü döşekten uzak tutması ve genel uzaklaşma kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iyiliğin ve bağı sürdürmenin karşıtını, ilişkinin bırakılmasını, kötü geçimi ve davranıştaki sertliği birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi bu kişiler arası çekirdeği ve ona bağlı nitelemeleri doğru sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki uzaklık kişiler arası ilgi, bağ ve davranışla ilgilidir; fiziksel olarak bir yüzeye oturmama anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: İlişkiyi sürdürmeme çekirdeği ile bağ kesme derecesini ve yapı ya da huy sertliğini belirten özel kullanımlar ayrılır; niteleme kalıbı bütün dala genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiye iyilik ve yakınlık göstermemek, onunla bağı sürdürmeyip uzak durmak ve ilişkide sert davranmaktır. Bağın daha kararlı biçimde bırakılması ile yapı veya huy bakımından katı ve geçimsiz olma, bu çekirdeğin özel görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Kişiler arasındaki iyilik ve yakınlık bağı gözetilmez, ilişki sürdürülmez.
Bağı bırakma, geçici soğukluktan daha yerleşik ve kararlı bir kopuş derecesine varabilir.
Kötü geçim, kaba davranma ve insan ilişkilerinde incelik göstermeme bu uzaklığın davranışsal görünümüdür.
Belirli niteleme kalıbında kişi, yapı veya huy bakımından katı ve geçimsiz diye tanımlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi iyilik ve ilişki bağının karşıtıdır; bağı bırakma, kötü geçim ve sert davranış aynı kişiler arası uzaklığın dereceleri veya belirtileri olarak sunulur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi selin sürüp attığı veya vadi ile kaynayan kabın kenarlara fırlattığı köpük, çöp ve süprüntüyü açıkça tanımlar. Dal çerçevesi hem atılan maddeyi hem buna bağlı atılma kullanımlarını doğru temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, akış ya da kaynama sırasında kenara atılan değersiz artık ve köpüktür; toplumsal sertlik veya genel yere serme eylemi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Atılmış artık adı, atılıp yok olma sözü ve vadi ya da kabın artığı dışarı atmasını bildiren biçimler ayrı tutulur; sonuç adı bütün eylem kullanımlarının yerine geçirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Selin, vadinin veya kaynayan bir kabın akıştan ayırıp kenara attığı köpük, çöp ve hafif süprüntüdür. Buna bağlı kullanımlar, böyle bir artığın dışarı atılmasını ve kalıcı olmayıp yok olmasını anlatır.

facets.statement: Akış veya kaynama, köpük ve hafif artığı ana maddeden ayırıp kenara atar.
Dal, selin ya da kabın dışarı attığı köpük, çöp ve süprüntünün adı olarak kullanılır.
Atılan köpüğe benzetilen şey, kalmayıp işe yaramadan yok olur.
Vadi çöp ve köpüğü kıyıya atar; kaynayan kap da köpüğünü dışarı çıkarır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, selin veya kaynayan kabın ayırıp kenara attığı köpük ve hafif artığı ortak çekirdek sayar; atılma eylemi ile kalmadan yok olma kullanımı bu görüntüye bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Selin, vadinin veya kaynayan kabın ana akıştan ayırıp dış yana attığı hafif artığın tamamını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Artığın köpük veya süprüntü oluşunu ve akıştan ayrılarak kenara atılmasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Akarsuyun taşıdığı hafif artıkların ana akıştan ayrılıp kıyıda biriktiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Akışın hafif artığı ayırıp kenara atması ve artık niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kaynayan kabın köpüğünü ve kalmadan yok olma uzantısını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Köpük gibi kalıcı değeri bulunmadan ortadan kaybolan bir şeyi anlatan benzetmeli kullanım içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Artık gibi dışarı atılma ve geride kalmama sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Maddenin köpük, çöp veya süprüntü olarak somut adlandırılmasını kapsamaz.

vadinin çöp ve köpüğü kıyıya atması

neighbor_distinctions.gloss: sel veya kabın dışarı attığı köpüklü artık
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da vadi ya da kaynayan kabın kenara attığı köpük, çöp ve hafif artığı aynı sınırlarla adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdek, kapsam ve katılımcı ilişkileri aynıdır; komşu karttaki yüzeye çıkma ve sıyrılma, aynı artığın gerçekleşme biçimleridir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Artığın akış veya kaynama tarafından kenara atılması ve elenmiş sonuç olması belirleyicidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Suyun üstünde yüzen, taşınan veya üst üste biriken değersiz madde, henüz kenara atılmadan da adlandırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kenara atılmış artık ile yüzen süprüntü
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da suyun taşıdığı köpük, kuru bitki ve hafif çöp gibi değersiz maddeleri kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal seçilip dış yana atılma sonucunu gerektirir; komşu dalda yüzme, taşınma ve üst üste birikme yeterlidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Köpüğün yanında çöp ve süprüntü bulunabilir ve bunlar akıştan dışarı atılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Beyaz köpüğün sıvı yüzeyinde oluşması ve yüzmesi, dışarı atılma şartı olmadan çekirdektir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: dışarı atılan artık ile yüzey köpüğü
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Köpük, iki dalın kesiştiği somut madde türüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal köpüğü değersiz artık olarak ayırıp kenara atan süreci içerir; komşu dal yalnızca sıvının üstündeki köpüğün kendisini adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Akışın ya da kaynamanın ayırdığı köpük ve süprüntü, ortaya çıkan artık olarak öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişinin devrilmesi, bir şeyin sökülüp atılması veya kabın eğilip boşaltılması doğrudan eylemdir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: atılmış artık ile yerinden çıkarıp atma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden ayırıp dışarı atma görüntüsü bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğal akışın elediği artık ve onun yok oluşunu, komşu dal ise bir etkileyenin nesneyi devirmesi, sökmesi veya boşaltmasını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; tam örtüşen artık dalı ile yüzen madde, yüzey köpüğü ve genel atma eylemi arasındaki sınırlar yayımlandı.
branches.branch_image_ar: الجفاء المطروح عن السيل أو القدر
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجفاء بمعنى ما ينفيه السيل أو يرمي به الوادي أو القدر من الزبد والقذى والغثاء إلى الجوانب.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو جفاء الصلة والعشرة، ولا مطلق اقتلاع الشيء أو صرع الشخص.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجفاء ما نفاه السيل (maqayis;sihah)؛ الزبد يذهب جفاء (sihah;mufradat)؛ ما يرمي به الوادي أو القدر من الغثاء إلى جوانبه (mufradat)؛ أجفأت القدر زبدها ألقته (maqayis;mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi yere sermeyi, bir şeyi kökünden söküp atmayı ve kabı eğerek içindekini dökmeyi aynı dalda toplar. Yerinden çıkarma ve devirme ortak görüntüdür; ancak kuvvet vurgusu yere serme ile sökmede açıkken kabı eğip boşaltmanın zorunlu bir parçası değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yerinden çıkarma, devirme ve boşaltma eylemlerini kapsar; her gerçekleşmede aynı ölçüde güç kullanıldığı ileri sürülmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, belirli bir söz öbeğine indirgenmeden yerinden çıkarma veya devirerek dışarı atma çekirdeğiyle tanımlanır; kişi, bitki ve kap kullanımları bunun ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığı bulunduğu yerden veya dengeden çıkarıp atmak ya da devirmektir: kişi yere serilir, nesne kökünden sökülüp atılır, kap ise eğilip içindekiler dışarı dökülür. Kuvvet özellikle yere serme ve sökme gerçekleşmelerinde belirgindir.

facets.statement: Bir varlık bulunduğu yerden veya dengesinden çıkarılır ve aşağıya ya da dışarıya yöneltilir.
Bir kişi güç uygulanarak yere serilir ve yere çarpacak biçimde devrilir.
Bitki veya başka bir nesne yerinden ya da kökünden sökülür ve ardından atılır.
Bir kap devrilir veya eğilir; bunun sonucunda içindeki madde dışarı dökülür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kişiyi yere serme, nesneyi söküp atma ve kabı eğip boşaltma kullanımlarını ortak bir yerinden çıkarma ve dışarı yöneltme görüntüsünde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişiyi yere serme, nesneyi söküp atma ve kabı eğerek içindekini dökme gerçekleşmelerinin tümünü korur.

error_profile.preserves: Yerinden ayırma, dengeyi bozma ve dışarı atma sonuçlarının üç gerçekleşmesini de korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin güç uygulanarak dengesinin bozulduğu ve yere düşürüldüğü bağlam içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiyi dengesinden çıkarıp yere düşürme işlemini tam olarak korur.
error_profile.loses: Nesneyi kökünden söküp atma ve kabı eğip boşaltma gerçekleşmelerini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir bitkinin veya başka bir nesnenin bağlı olduğu yerden çıkarılıp atıldığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bağlı nesneyi yerinden çıkarma ve ardından atma aşamalarını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişiyi yere serme ve kabı eğerek içindekini dökme gerçekleşmelerini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kabın devrilmesi veya yana yatırılmasıyla içindeki maddenin dışarı boşaltıldığı bağlam içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Kabın dengesini değiştirip içindeki maddeyi dışarı çıkarma sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişiyi yere serme ile nesneyi kökünden söküp atma kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Nesneyi kökünden sökme ve kabı eğip boşaltma, kişiyle sınırlı olmayan ek gerçekleşmelerdir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişiyi taşıdıktan sonra yere atma, komşu dalda ayrıca açıkça belirtilebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yerinden çıkarıp atma ile kişiyi yere serme

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yere sermenin yanında nesne sökme ve kap boşaltmayı da kapsar; komşu dalın çekirdeği kişiyi yere atma olayında yoğunlaşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kökünden sökme ve kabı eğerek boşaltma kullanımları da dalın kapsamındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsanın yere düşmesi veya doğrudan yere atılması tek başına dalın merkezi alanını oluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kişinin kuvvetle yere düşürülmesi iki dalda da doğal bir karşılık bulur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal farklı nesne türlerine yayılan yerinden çıkarma ailesidir; komşu dal yalnız yere serme ve yere düşme olayını merkez alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Söküp atma ve bir kabın içindekini dökme, yana düşürme şartı olmadan da bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin özellikle yan tarafı üzerine ve ağır biçimde düşmesi belirleyicidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin dengesini bozup yere düşürülmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal düşme yönünü belirlemez ve başka nesnelere de yayılır; komşu dal yan üzerine düşürmeyi özel sonuç olarak sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Etkileyen bir güç kişiyi, nesneyi veya kabı yerinden ya da dengesinden çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sel veya kaynama sırasında ayrılan köpük ve süprüntü, atılmış artık olarak adlandırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: etkin biçimde atma ile atılmış artık
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda yerinden ayrılıp dışarı yönelen bir varlık bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir devirme, sökme veya boşaltma eylemidir; komşu dal ise akışın elediği maddenin adı ve onun atılma durumudur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ülkenin veya toprağın iyiliğinin gitmesini, özellikle bitkisinin yenip tükenmesini ve toprağın elenmiş artık gibi verimsiz kalmasını bildirir. Dal çerçevesi bu üretkenlik kaybını doğru verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek toprağın yararını ve bitkisel verimini yitirmesidir; yalnız kuraklık durumu veya hayvanın sürülürken yorulması değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, belirli bir söz öbeğine bağlanmadan ülke veya toprağın verimli niteliğini yitirmesi olarak tanımlanır; bitkinin yenmesi bunun belirtilen nedenidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir ülkenin veya toprağın bitkisel iyiliğini ve verimini yitirmesidir. Bitkinin otlanıp tükenmesi bu kayba yol açabilir ve toprak sonunda değersiz bir artık gibi yararsız kalır.

facets.statement: Ülke veya toprak, bitki ve üretkenlik bakımından sahip olduğu iyiliği yitirir.
Toprağın bitkisi yenip tüketildiğinde verim kaybı gerçekleşir.
Verimini yitiren toprak, akışın ayırıp attığı yararsız artığa benzetilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar toprağın iyiliğini yitirmesinde birleşir; bitkinin yenip tükenmesi somut açıklama, yararsız artığa dönüşme görüntüsü ise sonuç nitelemesidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ülke veya toprağın bitkisel iyiliğinin tükenmesini, nedeni özellikle otlanma olduğunda da kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Toprağın önceki üretken niteliğini kaybetmesini ve yararsızlaşma sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Toprağın verimini, üzerindeki bitkinin hayvanlarca tüketilmesi sonucunda kaybettiği bağlam içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkinin yenmesi yoluyla gerçekleşen verim kaybını somut biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Nedeni belirtilmeyen genel iyilik kaybını ve yararsız artık benzetmesini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ülke veya toprağın önceki bitkisel üretkenliğini yitirdiği genel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İyilik ve üretkenlik kaybının genel sonucunu doğal biçimde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdek, kapsam ve sonuç aynıdır; komşu karttaki otlanma ve kuraklığın bitkiyi tüketmesi aynı verim kaybının nedenleridir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Toprağın bitkisinin yenmesi ve iyiliğinin gitmesi sonuç olarak öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsan veya hayvanın çaba sınırına varması ve toprağın çok ekimle dinlenemeyecek kadar tüketilmesi daha geniş bir tükenme alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: verim kaybı ile aşırı kullanımdan tükenme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Toprağın yoğun kullanım sonunda üretkenliğini kaybetmesi iki dalın kesiştiği alandır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal toprağın iyiliğinin gitmesini ve bitkisinin tükenmesini adlandırır; komşu dal bunu aşırı çaba ve yinelenen ekimle tükenmenin bir örneği sayar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Daha önce var olan bitkisel iyiliğin yenerek veya başka biçimde tükenmesi bir değişimdir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yağmurun, otun ve verimin bulunmadığı kuru dönem veya verimsiz yer bir durum olarak adlandırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da toprağın bitki ve üretkenlik bakımından yetersiz kalmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal iyiliğin ortadan kalkması sürecini öne çıkarır; komşu dal yağmursuzluk ve otsuzluk durumunu, önceki bir kaybı şart koşmadan adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Toprak bitkisel iyiliğini ve üretkenliğini kaybeder.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Toprak kolay ve bol bitki veren verimli niteliğe sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal toprağın bitki yetiştirme gücünü ve üretken niteliğini değerlendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal üretkenliğin ortadan kalkmasını, komşu dal ise bitkinin kolay, iyi veya bol yetişmesini bildirir.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو السفينة الفارغة، ولا إجفاء الماشية بالسوق الشديد.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hayvanları sert biçimde sürerek yormayı ve yemelerine fırsat vermemeyi birlikte şart koşar. Dal çerçevesi eylemi, yöntemi ve iki sonucu eksiksiz korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnız hayvanları sertçe sürüp yorarak yemden alıkoyan kurulu kullanıma aittir; genel yorgunluk veya her türlü hayvan sürme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız hayvanları sertçe sürme kalıbına bağlıdır; yorma ya da yemden alıkoyma anlamı kökün yalın ve sınırsız anlamı gibi genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Hayvanları sert ve aralıksız biçimde sürerek yormak, bu sürüş sırasında otlayıp yemelerine fırsat vermemektir.

facets.statement: Sürücü, hayvanları sert ve yorucu bir sürüşe zorlar.
Sert sürüş hayvanları yorar ve onların durup yemesine izin vermez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dalda kaynaklar arası ortaklaştırma yapılamaz; anlam tek tanıklıkta sert sürüş, yorma ve yemeye fırsat vermeme şartlarıyla sınırlanır.

source_details.summary: Hayvanlar sertçe sürülür, bu yüzden yorulur ve yol boyunca yemelerine izin verilmez.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sert sürüş, bunun doğurduğu yorgunluk ve hayvanların yemekten alıkonması birlikte bulunduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sert sürüşü, yorgunluğu ve yemeye fırsat verilmemesini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanların sürüş yüzünden yorulduğu ve durup otlamasına fırsat verilmediği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Aralıksız sürüşü ve hayvanların yorulmasını doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Yemeye izin verilmeme koşulunu ancak bağlam desteğiyle sezdirir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sürüşün sertliği ve hayvanların yol üzerinde yemden alıkonması özellikle vurgulandığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sert sürüşü, yemden alıkoymayı ve bunun yorucu niteliğini birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir hayvanı veya başka birini sürekli yol ya da işle yormak, sürü ve yem bağlamı olmadan da gerçekleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yemletmeden sert sürme ile sürekli yorup tüketme

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanın veya hayvanın böğrünü, bir şeyin yanını ve bu temel anlamdan gelişen bitişik çevreyi birlikte doğrular. Vadi ve ordu gibi yapıların iki yanı ile böğürden alınan deri parçası, aynı yan bölge çekirdeğinin belirli uygulamalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca uzak durmayı değil, somut bir yanı, yan bölgeyi veya ona bitişik çevreyi bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanıma dayanır; tanım, özel bir söz öbeğine bağlı anlamları çekirdeğe katmadan yan ve bitişik çevre alanını kapsar.

concept_map.definition: İnsan ya da hayvan gövdesinin böğrü veya herhangi bir şeyin yanı ve bu yana bitişik yakın çevredir. İki yandan oluşan düzenlerde her bir yanı, ayrıca böğürden alınan deri parçasını da adlandırabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan veya hayvan bedeninin böğrünü ve bir şeyin yanını ya da tarafını belirtir.
Bir evin veya topluluğun yerleşimine bitişik yakın çevreyi belirtebilir.
Vadi, ordu veya ırmak gibi bir bütünün iki yanından her birini belirtir.
Devenin böğründen alınan ve kap yapımında kullanılabilen deri parçasını belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Anlamın ortak çekirdeği bedenin veya bir nesnenin yanıdır. Yakın çevre, iki yandan biri ve böğür derisinden alınan parça bu mekansal çekirdeğin belirli uzantılarıdır.

Bu nedenle dal korunur, fakat her yapının yalnızca fiziksel komşuluk diye genellenmemesi gerekir.

Yolculukta bir kimsenin yanında bulunan eşlikçiyi belirtir.
Belirli dinsel yapılarda yakınlık yanında buyruk, iş veya izlenen yol anlamını taşır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel uzaklık veya bedensel yan anlamını değil, cinsel ilişki sonrası arınmaya dek süren dinsel kısıtlılığı belirtir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın bir dinsel durum ve bu durumdaki kişi anlamındadır; genel uzak durma anlamı tanıma taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Cinsel ilişki sonrasında arınma yapılıncaya kadar kişinin namazdan ve mescitten uzak durduğu dinsel durumdur. Bu durumda bulunan kadın, erkek veya topluluk da aynı adlandırmayla nitelenebilir.

facets.statement: Cinsel ilişki sonrasında arınma gerektiren ve kişiyi namazdan ve mescitten uzak tutan durumu belirtir.
Bu durumda bulunan kadın, erkek veya birden çok kişiyi niteleyebilir.
Adlandırma, kişinin arınana kadar namazdan ve mescitten uzak durmasıyla açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak tanım, cinsel ilişki sonrasında başlayan ve arınmaya kadar kişiyi namazdan ve mescitten uzak tutan durumdur. Durumun adı, bu uzak durmayla ilişkilendirilir.

concept_gloss.text: cinsel ilişki sonrası arınma gerektiren dinsel durum
concept_gloss.applicability: Durumun sebebi, geçici dinsel kısıtı ve arınmayla sona ermesi birlikte anlatılmak istendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Cinsel ilişki sonrası oluşmayı, dinsel kısıtı ve arınma gereğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Cinsel ilişki sonrası geçici dinsel kısıt altında bulunan kişinin nitelenmesinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin arınma gerektiren geçici durumunu bağlam içinde korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: cinsel ilişkiden sonra arınana dek dinsel kısıt altında bulunan kişi

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Evlilikten ve cinsel ilişkiden sürekli ya da iradi biçimde uzak durmayı belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal ilişkiye girmemeyi seçme veya sürdürme halidir; bu dal ise ilişki gerçekleştikten sonra arınmaya kadar doğan geçici dinsel durumdur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رجل أو امرأة أو قوم جنب، أصابته الجنابة، أجنب أو جنب أو اجتنب أو تجنب، وسبب التسمية بتجنب الصلاة أو مواضعها حتى الطهر.
